derivation_notes: Convention-locked from Class A GPCR mechanism literature (Ballesteros-Weinstein numbering). NOT empirically re-derived here — locked prior to Block A.

Empirically derived from 4 tier-1 paired Class B receptors (GLP1R,GCGR,PTH1R,CRHR1). Direction: active>inactive. Active range 24.53-26.88 Å; inactive range 13.05-14.94 Å. 36 candidate pairs evaluated (C(9,2)). Second-best pair 3.46-6.34 margin=9.01 Å (adjacent, structurally equivalent). Wootten 6.34 chosen over 6.30 because GCGR lacks GPCRdb-tagged 6.30 (helix ends at 6.33 in Wootten annotation); 6.34 available across all four tier-1 receptors and is the analog of Class A 6.30 (TM6 intracellular tip).

Empirically derived from 4 tier-1 paired Class F receptors (FZD4 [DVL-stabilized],FZD6 [Gs],FZD7 [Gs],SMO [Gi]). Direction: active>inactive. Active range 13.49-15.06 Å; inactive range 9.12-11.69 Å. 21 candidate pairs evaluated (C(7,2)). Margin substantially smaller than Class B (1.80 vs 9.59 Å) — Class F TM6 rearrangement on activation is more subtle, consistent with the atypical Class F activation mechanism (no canonical D[E]RY→ionic-lock breakage; SMO/FZD activation via Wnt/Hedgehog is transducer-recruitment rather than canonical Gα-vestibule opening).
